subtitulo: Existence, known place, useful instance, distance and map
introPt: A traveller needs a pharmacy in a historic-centre street. Listen as the question grows only when the previous answer is still usable.
cenario: A local confirms a pharmacy exists, gives a long route and then moves the useful part onto the map.

dialogo.pt: Is there a pharmacy around here?

dialogo.es: Sí, hay una en la esquina.
dialogo.pinyin: see, eye OO-nah en lah ehs-KEE-nah
dialogo.pt: Yes, there is one on the corner.

dialogo.es: Siga derecho, cruce la avenida y dé vuelta después del mercado.
dialogo.pinyin: SEE-gah deh-REH-choh, KROO-seh lah ah-beh-NEE-dah ee deh BWEHL-tah dehs-PWEHS del mehr-KAH-doh
dialogo.pt: Go straight, cross the avenue and turn after the market.

dialogo.es: ¿Está lejos? ¿Me lo muestra en el mapa?
dialogo.pinyin: ehs-TAH LEH-hohs. meh loh MWEHS-trah en el MAH-pah
dialogo.pt: Is it far? Can you show me on the map?

dialogo.es: No. Está a dos cuadras. Es aquí.
dialogo.pinyin: noh. ehs-TAH ah dohs KWAH-drahs. ehs ah-KEE
dialogo.pt: No. It is two blocks away. It is here.

perguntas.pergunta: Why start with ¿Hay una farmacia por aquí?
opcoes: Yes or no is already useful
perguntas.explica: The first answer establishes whether the useful category exists nearby.

perguntas.pergunta: Which question finds the known bathroom in this café?
perguntas.explica: Está locates the defined place inside the current setting.

perguntas.pergunta: Which question looks for any pharmacy?
perguntas.explica: Dónde hay finds any useful instance of the category.

perguntas.pergunta: What does ¿Está lejos? do after a long route?
opcoes: Collapses the answer into a distance decision
perguntas.explica: Near or far is easier to act on than a paragraph of directions.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the final repair when the turns still do not survive?
opcoes: Move the point onto the map
perguntas.explica: The map externalises the route and reuses B03's repair strategy.
